steps.name: An Unexpected Meeting (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in 「Kali」, then defeat [Lethe of Oblivion] in 「Lake of Oblivion」 and obtain <Tear of Illusion>. Then report to [Veled] in 「Phobos」.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Welcome, %s. What brings you here?
(Medea greets the adventurer warmly with a radiant smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Has she ever looked this happy to see someone?)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Why are you standing there blankly? Didn't you have business here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes... I came to thank you for helping Minuet.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hehe, it was nothing. Come, let's have some tea and talk of other things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You know the name of this tea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. When you gave me some before...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Oh, so I told you. Here you are.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What an interesting person. Go on, drink.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something feels different. Could she be someone other than Medea...?)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You're very suspicious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to think of it, something feels wrong about Kali.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You haven't touched your tea. I thought you might suspect.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're not Medea. You... Your manner of speaking is similar, but...
(Medea's form slowly fades like an illusion.)
My beloved Medea is away for a moment. I only came to see the village she built for our people. I have no other intention.
And now I know how deeply you trust her. I felt her trust in you as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're...

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Perhaps I am the person you think I am.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Until next time. It's unfortunate that you have so much to do... What Weiss intends will be more than enough to occupy you.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Oh, I hid "Illusion's Tears" for you by the lake at Zisk's Estate. Go find them... If you want to know their use, ask the tempting demon...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's gone...
(As the woman's voice fades, the strange atmosphere filling Kali returns to normal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The lake at Zisk's Estate, and the tempting demon... Veled...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At this point, I need to know...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What she's trying to tell me...

steps.name: An Unexpected Meeting (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Lethe of Oblivion] in 「Lake of Oblivion」 and obtain <Tear of Illusion>. Then report to [Medea] in 「Kali」.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Welcome, %s. I was just looking for you. There's something I wanted to discuss.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to talk too. But you were looking for me?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yes. Not about my beauty, though.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a relief... No, sorry.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I know you lack aesthetic sensibility, so there's no need to apologize. Peonia told me to compliment you next time we met.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Was that a compliment?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yes. It was.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahaha... So what did you want to say?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: No, you first. You didn't come for nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, take this. Someone told me to bring it to you.
(Veled takes the Illusion's Tears and studies them.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: So this was it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...You know what it is?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I recently dreamed of the being who was my master. Asmodea... He was holding this. He was delighted, saying the Illusion's Tears would make his wish come true sooner.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it a memory shared by you and Asmodea?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I don't know. Whether it's a real memory or an illusion-like dream...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Asmodea has vanished. I sense nothing in the well that led to Rosengarten. That's why I need to know.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Was I cast out? Did I come out to play? Or did I choose to come here...? I don't know any of it.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm a being made from jumbled memories and a magic stone. Perhaps this could be a clue.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The person who told me to find it said you'd know if I brought it to you.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Who was that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure either.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Really? %s, may I use this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. That's why I brought it to you. But how do you use it? Oh, Veled?
(Veled holds the Illusion's Tears against his rose pendant. Violet light begins circling him.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: ...This was made from one of Weiss's magic stones too. Like me... They're resonating... I think I understand a little...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I wanted to see more, but that must have been the limit. It's gone. Sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you learn something? Can you tell me?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's a little unclear, but I'll explain. Weiss's magic stones are no ordinary stones. He extracts magic from living beings, refines it, places it inside, and adds souls.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Those souls didn't belong to the incubi. Witches created and inserted them as they pleased. That's why my memories are such a mess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Witches...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm a doll made from Asmodea's power mixed with a magic stone into which a witch placed a soul.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: As planned, I should have awakened, filled the gaps in Asmodea's soul, and been discarded. But a witch played a trick, and I was lucky enough to survive.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Normally, both Asmodea and Weiss would notice a trick like that...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Thank you. It helped. That's everything I learned.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You look disappointed. Sorry there wasn't anything you wanted to know. Shall I tell you about beauty instead?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...No, thank you.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: No need to be shy, but Peonia told me not to do that, so I won't.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: The one who hid this must be a witch. Deliberately provoking you like that...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: She sent you a message through me. Find another one of these and give it to the child she loves.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Apparently, you'll need another Illusion's Tears.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The child she loves...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...She probably hid another in the same place. Thank you, Veled. I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Oh, already gone. I was going to talk about %s's soul... Is it all right not to mention it?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'd better retrieve the tent that blew away first...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's you. I said I would call you myself, yet you came anyway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness. It really is you, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: When have I ever been anyone else...?
(Medea nods, apparently realizing something.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Give me what you're carrying. And...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What did she say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To give it to the child she loves.
(Medea carefully holds the Illusion's Tears. When she whispers in an unknown language, they spread like droplets, circle her, and disappear.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...She truly is impossible to understand. I never know what she's thinking...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry you encountered her while I was away...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I only came to thank you for helping Minuet...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Surely you have questions. Aren't you going to ask?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll wait.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Wait...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I believe you're trying to find a way.
(Medea looks briefly surprised, then regains her composure.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Interesting. You really are...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm only sorry that the time isn't now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm a little curious. How much trust have I earned now?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: On your way, please tell Shynic I'm well. And there's no need to worry too much about me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's avoiding the question. Can't be helped.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. I'll give Shynic your regards. See you next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tartarus wasn't in my plans, but shall I visit...?)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...Your goddess will be all right too. Travel safely...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Beinan...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: You called?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I seem to have delayed my choice so long that she appeared herself. I will be away for longer as well.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So I intend to strengthen the barrier. Is that all right?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Of course. We trust you, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, Beinan. I'll make the preparations.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: (Now they only need to brave the fierce blizzard...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, you're here. Welcome! ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Your power definitely feels different. The goddess's blessing is stronger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You noticed.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I don't know the details, but...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hmm... Sniff, sniff... The smell is weaker too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth do I smell like...?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Boredom. ♡ You know that by now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I'm a dull human...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Medea asked me to give you her regards.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You've been to Kali? All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What were you doing? It doesn't look very entertaining.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: People can't spend their whole lives only doing fun things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That sounds strange coming from you...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I could make something very unfun happen right now. Want to see? ♡
(Shynic thrusts her gleaming Death Scythe forward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...No. Not at all. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: All right. ♡ It's nothing much. I'm thinking of releasing some magic I sealed away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I had no use for it, so I sealed it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has something happened?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Not right now. Someday, perhaps? Don't worry about it. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Sealed power...? That's frightening, yet she says not to worry. Is she joking? I can't tell...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvic made Priring curry for dinner. Stay and eat. Don't worry, there aren't any Prirings in it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Shynic. I'm hungry, so I'd be glad to.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll come in a little while. Go to Melvic first, all right? Oh, ask him to draw a Priring on my plate. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm getting hungry. Just finish tidying up, then go?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Humans really are interesting. Even when we feel awful...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Even when we're suffering, we get hungry.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (So all %s needs now is Io's power and Medea's?)
